name: Hearth sausage
summary: Lạp xưởng gác bếp is the hearth sausage Bao Son La names at the night market beside dried buffalo. It is kept apart from lạp trâu. A recipe was not printed. The price is Check on arrival.
origin: The Moc Chau night market. Bao Son La, 27 January 2023.
howToEat: Eat it with dried buffalo and a cup of strong wine. A recipe is Check on arrival.

where: The food side of the night market around the Pha Luong light park. No stall is a pick.
